newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth to buy South Florida Television for $48 million.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth to buy South Florida Television for $48 million.

text.p: BellSouth Corp. said Thursday it agreed to buy South Florida Television Inc., which holds the rights to provide wireless cable TV service in Miami, for $48 million in stocks and cash.

BellSouth will acquire South Florida Television from its owner, National Wireless Holdings Inc., in a deal that the company said would allow it to take a major step toward providing cable service to South Florida.
The company said it would use the rights to broadcast a 100-plus channel digital wireless cable TV service to 1.2 million potential customers in Miami.
BellSouth has previously announced plans to offer digital wireless cable service in New Orleans and Atlanta.
The acquisition is expected to be completed by mid-summer.
BellSouth's stock was off 25 cents at $45.75 on the New York Stock Exchange, and National Wireless lost 25 cents at $14 on the Nasdaq market.
